scientific_approval_reference: USER_DIRECTIVE_2026-09-13_PUSH_UNTIL_CANNOT_PUSH_FURTHER; chronic source-specific design adjudicated prospectively from source provenance, PBS-only design-input qualification, and pre-outcome long-geometry synthetic calibration before CTX temporal fitting
rank_robustness_rule: Run the same frozen chronic pipeline independently at r=2 and r=3. Neither rank is primary and no rank may be selected after CTX outcomes. Any disagreement on a frozen material conclusion returns REPRESENTATION_DEPENDENT_NO_TRANSFER for that conclusion.
source_semantics: RSEM gene-count output already upper-quartile normalized in the public processed table; source values are fractional normalized count-like abundances, not raw library counts
normalization_rule: Use the hash-bound public GSE98812 processed values directly. Require all selected values to be finite and nonnegative, then transform x = log2(source_value + 1). Do not recompute CPM, library-size normalization, upper-quartile normalization, or any treatment-dependent normalization. Apply the identical transform to PBS and 100 nM cetuximab states.
feature_universe_rule: Use the frozen GSE98812 gene-row universe exactly as provided and require one nonblank unique GENE identifier per row. Using only the 11 PBS weekly states and pre-log normalized source values, retain a gene iff source_value >= 1 in at least 6 of 11 PBS states. Cetuximab values are forbidden from feature selection. The retained feature set is frozen across r=2/r=3 and every later refit or sensitivity. The source paper's time-course fold-change-selected gene subset is not used because it is outcome-dependent for this purpose.
basis_rule: After the frozen log2(source_value + 1) transform and PBS-only feature gate, center each retained gene by its mean across the eleven PBS weekly states. Fit SVD/PCA using those PBS states only with no gene-wise variance standardization. Project all PBS and cetuximab states through that already-fitted PBS basis. Canonicalize each component sign by finding the loading with maximum absolute magnitude and flipping the component when that loading is negative. Fit and report r=2 and r=3 independently.
trajectory_rule: Use only C1.PBS through C11.PBS and C1.100nM through C11.100nM. Construct ten within-PBS weekly transitions C1->C2 through C10->C11 and ten within-cetuximab weekly transitions C1->C2 through C10->C11, for 20 total source-native weekly transitions. There is no shared measured day-0 state in this processed trajectory. Do not import the separate baseline state, stable resistant clone states, methylation states, proliferation values, ATAC states, or scRNA states into this first chronic transcriptomic state model.
d1_model: x_next = T*x_now + B*u + c, with u=0 PBS and u=1 cetuximab
d2_model: x_next = T_control*x_now + u*DeltaT*x_now + B*u + c, so T_treated = T_control + DeltaT
model_opening_rule: Fit D1 and D2 prospectively at both A3 ranks. Unlike the short-term 5+5 pilot, D2 is not gated behind D1 adequacy in the chronic 10+10 geometry because the pre-outcome long-geometry known-truth calibration established that D2 can become identifiable and predictively recoverable here while D1 remains favored under D1 truth. No chronic outcome values entered this model-opening choice.
conditioning_refusal_rule: For each full fit and every leave-one-transition refit, require exact declared-design full column rank under the matrix-rank implementation. Separately compute a scale-normalized design condition number by dividing every nonzero design column by its Euclidean norm before SVD. Any zero-norm required predictor, nonfinite singular value, loss of full rank, or scaled condition number > 67108864 (=1/sqrt(float64 machine epsilon)) returns REFUSE_ILL_CONDITIONED_DESIGN. Passing this numerical ceiling does not establish predictive adequacy.
comparison_tolerance_rule: A predictive error or spectral difference is strictly ordered only when it differs by more than 32*float64_epsilon*max(1,abs(reference_value),abs(candidate_value)). Values within this tolerance are treated as numerically tied.
baseline_rule: At each A3 rank evaluate the same two frozen predictive baselines across all 20 transitions: persistence pred=x_now, and an arm-specific leave-one-transition-out mean-next-state baseline estimated from the remaining transitions of the omitted transition's own arm.
d1_adequacy_rule: At each rank, D1 is predictively adequate only if its full fit and every one of 20 D1 leave-one-transition-out refits pass rank/conditioning and aggregate D1 LOTO NRMSE is strictly lower than BOTH the persistence NRMSE and arm-specific LOTO mean-next-state NRMSE under the frozen comparison tolerance. D1 adequacy is reported independently of D2 support.
d2_reorganization_support_rule: At each rank, D2 earns predictive operator-reorganization support only if its full fit and every one of 20 D2 LOTO refits pass rank/conditioning; aggregate D2 LOTO NRMSE is strictly lower than BOTH frozen baseline NRMSE values AND strictly lower than D1 aggregate LOTO NRMSE; and D2 has strictly lower per-transition relative prediction error than D1 on at least 12 of 20 omitted transitions. The 12/20 threshold preserves the prospectively used 60-percent win fraction from the short-term 6/10 rule and is fixed before chronic CTX opening. Support must be earned at BOTH r=2 and r=3 for a cross-rank REORGANIZATION_SUPPORTED conclusion.
uncertainty_rule: Do not use an iid bootstrap over serial weeks and do not report serial refits as biological-replicate confidence intervals. For each model/rank the prespecified model-conditional sensitivity envelope consists of: point fit; all admissible leave-one-transition refits; one paired earliest-transition block refit omitting PBS C1->C2 and cetuximab C1->C2 together; and eleven leave-one-PBS-state basis refits in which the frozen feature set is retained, the PBS basis is refit on the remaining ten PBS states, all 22 states are reprojected, and the declared model is refit on all 20 transitions. Any required sensitivity refit failure makes the associated spectral conclusion INDETERMINATE.
mathematical_side_rule: For any operator family, BELOW requires rho<1 for the point fit and every admissible required sensitivity refit; ABOVE requires rho>1 for the point fit and every admissible required sensitivity refit; otherwise return INDETERMINATE. Equality to 1 within the frozen numerical comparison tolerance is boundary-touching and therefore INDETERMINATE. This is a mathematical discrete-time unit-circle classification only and is not a biological unity boundary.
d2_delta_rho_rule: Only when D2 predictive reorganization support is earned at both ranks may the sign of rho(T_treated)-rho(T_control) be interpreted. At a given rank the sign is POSITIVE, NEGATIVE, or ZERO_WITHIN_NUMERICAL_TOLERANCE only if that same sign holds for the point fit and every admissible required sensitivity refit; otherwise return INDETERMINATE. Cross-rank disagreement remains representation-dependent.
non_normal_warning_rule: Use rho<1 with sigma_max>1 as the existing asymptotic/transient non-normal warning. A sensitivity-level warning is PRESENT only when present throughout the admissible envelope, ABSENT only when absent throughout, and INDETERMINATE when it changes or a required refit refuses.
cross_rank_disposition_rule: A chronic model-level conclusion is transferable across A3 only when r=2 and r=3 give the same frozen categorical conclusion. D2 reorganization is REORGANIZATION_SUPPORTED only if D2 support is SUPPORTED at both ranks. D1 shared-operator adequacy is SHARED_OPERATOR_ADEQUATE only if D1 adequacy is PASS at both ranks. If neither D1 nor D2 beats the frozen baselines at both ranks, return NO_TRANSFER. Material rank disagreement returns REPRESENTATION_DEPENDENT_NO_TRANSFER rather than selecting a preferred rank.
transport_rule: The chronic operators are source-native one-week transition operators. Do not exponentiate, take matrix or spectral roots, or numerically convert them to the one-day GSE114446 operators. Cross-timescale comparison is limited initially to source-native categorical findings. Numerical daily-weekly transport requires a separately earned semigroup/time-homogeneity validation.
